description: Star Wars RPG — Zone and Planet data structure. All zone objects in PLANETS must conform to this shape.

Planet.name: string — display name
Planet.travelCost: integer — credits to hyperspace here (0 = starting planet)
Planet.startZoneId: string — zone id to spawn in on arrival
Planet.description: string — one-sentence lore blurb shown in action log on arrival
Planet.zones: object keyed by zone id — each value is a Zone

Zone.id: string — unique slug within the planet
Zone.name: string — display name
Zone.subtitle: string — planet and level info shown in header
Zone.width: integer — grid columns (no minimum/maximum — use what the design needs)
Zone.height: integer — grid rows (no minimum/maximum — use what the design needs)
Zone.accent: string — hex color, primary UI accent (e.g. '#8FA6FF')
Zone.accentDim: string — hex color, dark variant of accent
Zone.floorColor: string — hex color, primary floor tile
Zone.floorAlt: string — hex color, alternate floor tile for visual variation
Zone.wallDark: string — hex color, dark wall stripe
Zone.wallLight: string — hex color, light wall stripe
Zone.bg: string — CSS radial-gradient used as full-page background
Zone.decor: array of strings — floor decor kinds to scatter: 'cargo_crate' | 'pipe' | 'neon_sign' | 'pillar' | 'brazier' | 'archive' | 'girder' | 'slag' | 'root' | 'moss' | 'rubble' | 'cable_bundle' | 'scan_arch' | 'warning_beacon' | 'hazard_stripe'
Zone.archetypeProfiles: ZONE_ARCHETYPE_PROFILES constant (defined before StarWarsRPG() in star-wars-rpg.jsx) provides ready-made color/decor/ambient sets for six zone archetypes: 'exterior', 'interior_cantina', 'interior_slicer', 'interior_csf', 'interior_warehouse', 'interior_generic'. Copy from that constant rather than inventing values from scratch.
Zone.buildMap: function() — returns 2D array of { type } tile objects using carveRect() and pt() helpers

Door.x: integer — grid column of the door tile
Door.y: integer — grid row of the door tile
Door.targetZone: string — zone id to travel to (must exist in the same planet's zones)

targetPos.x: integer — must be a floor tile in targetZone

Door.label: string — short name shown on the door tile

notes.wall: Impassable. Blocks movement. Used for structural barriers.
notes.floor: Walkable. Entities (NPCs, collectibles, world objects, doors) must sit on floor tiles.
notes.door: Walkable. Triggers zone transition when stepped on. Must have a matching Door entry in zone.doors.
notes.ship_hull: Impassable. Steel panel visual. Used for ship interiors.
notes.ship_ramp: Walkable. Triggers the hyperspace travel overlay (TravelOverlay).

BuildMapHelpers.emptyGrid(w, h): Returns a w×h grid of wall tiles
BuildMapHelpers.carveRect(g, x1, y1, x2, y2, type): Sets all tiles in the rectangle to type (default 'floor')
